title: Final Temperature Estimate
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides a correct numerical estimate for the temperature T.

title: Correct Use of k
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly derives the de Broglie wave number k in terms of temperature T.

title: Condition Application
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the condition ka <= 1 to derive the temperature limit.

title: Correct Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student uses the correct values for the mass of hydrogen, Boltzmann constant, and Planck's constant.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake in any of the equations leading to the final result.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student omits any necessary factors or constants in the calculations.
